text:
The evidence confirms **67.7 ha of tree-cover loss in 2020**, but it does not establish whether that loss was deforestation. Tree-cover loss alone does not show whether the land was permanently converted from forest to another use.

For the separate period from 2021 through 2025, no loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected. The data did record 0.4 ha of loss in smaller patches in 2021. The JRC reference map also classified none of the property as forest in 2020, but that does not resolve the nature of the earlier loss.

This assessment is not a regulatory or compliance finding.
